input.standard: ASTM E741 (concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure the volume of air V_lab served by scrubber-1-v3, as V = Qe * tau, from the CO2 rise at reduced speed then the decay at full speed, with the lab occupant as the CO2 source.

monitoring.reason: FE-3 is the only occupant of the lab, the volume whose CO2 is raised; hab-b (3 people) is outside the volume under test and the hatch is held closed.

steps.why: Rise: scrubber at the signed speed floor so the lab CO2 climbs towards a higher equilibrium; hatch to hab-b held closed the whole test.
Decay: full speed (Qe = 1 m3/min), record the fall towards equilibrium; about one time constant for a guess of V = 30 m3 (tau = 30 min).

abort.when: CO2 at or above limits.co2AbortPpm (3000 ppm)
the device refuses a step's command
FE-3 out of the 45-120 bpm band, monitoring lost, or one more person entering the lab

expected.start: Lab CO2 about 1200 ppm (measured), one occupant awake at 0.38 L/min (0.26-0.45), hatch closed.
expected.step1: At 30 percent, Qe = 0.3 m3/min; with V about 30 m3 the equilibrium is about G/Qe = 0.00038/0.3 = 1270 ppm above the scrubbed baseline, so CO2 stays near or rises slightly above 1200 ppm (peak expected under 1600 ppm, well under the 2500 limit). A rise smaller than several hundred ppm is expected and is a limit of the 30 percent floor.
expected.step2: At 100 percent, CO2 falls exponentially towards an equilibrium of about G/Qe = 380 ppm above baseline with tau = V/Qe, about 30 min if V = 30 m3 (the scrubber lag of 3.33 min delays the start). Fit C(t) = C_eq + (C0 - C_eq) exp(-t/tau); V_lab = Qe * tau, expected 10-200 m3, first guess 30 m3.
expected.refuted_if: The hab-b CO2 moves in step with the lab (the closed hatch exchanges air), the fit residuals are not random (not one well-mixed zone), the fitted C_eq is inconsistent with the occupant rate, or the occupancy changes: then V is not valid.
expected.record: Lab CO2 every minute, the scrubber speed commands and their acceptance, hab-b CO2 (co2-2-v3) every minute.

hypotheses: The exchange through the closed hatch to hab-b (design 3 m3/min per station-topology, hatch closed) is not measured here; it is not assumed zero and would bias V high if present. Hab-b CO2 is recorded to reveal it.
The lab is one well-mixed zone; the occupant's CO2 rate is steady at the awake rate 0.38 L/min and the occupant stays in the lab.
Effective flow Qe = 1 m3/min at full speed and scales linearly with speed (scrubber-1-datasheet); lag 3.33 min is ignored in the fit window start.
If V is much larger than 30 m3 (tau well beyond 40 min) one decay phase covers less than one tau and V is only bounded.

justifications.reason: Rise limited by the 30 percent floor; keeps total within 60 min.
